name: brazil-crypto-tax
description: Prepare Brazilian resident individuals' 2026 crypto tax working papers and reporting handoffs. Distinguish domestic capital gains from qualifying foreign financial assets, identify disposal and receipt events, reconcile acquisition evidence and apply the dated IN 1888 to DeCripto transition. Covers Bitcoin, altcoins, stablecoins, NFT classification, domestic custodial lending, swaps, annual asset reporting, loss restrictions, reporting penalties and corrections. Trigger on Brazil crypto tax, criptoativos, Bitcoin, GCAP, DARF 4600, IN 1888, DeCripto, foreign exchange holdings, staking, mining, airdrops or NFT tax. Gives explicit unresolved treatment for unsupported native DeFi and cost-method questions; it does not assume every digital asset or yield product has the same tax regime.
